jobs.title: Supply Chain Support Manager
jobs.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Supply Chain Support Manager based in India.**

The Supply Chain Support Manager will play a hands-on role in managing day-to-day supply chain operations for a growing restaurant network. You will oversee inventory, purchasing, purchase orders, supplier coordination, replenishment, and supply chain reporting. The role combines operational execution with data analysis, allowing you to identify risks, resolve issues, and improve overall supply availability. You will work closely with suppliers and internal stakeholders to ensure orders are accurate, shipments remain on track, and inventory is effectively managed. Beyond managing daily priorities, you will identify cost-saving opportunities and help strengthen processes, reporting, and operational efficiency. This is a fully remote position offering the opportunity to take ownership, support a small team, and collaborate with a US-based organization.

### Accountabilities:

- Monitor inventory levels, product availability, usage, and movement to identify shortages, excess inventory, discrepancies, and potential supply risks.
- Support demand forecasting, replenishment planning, and inventory decisions using historical data and business requirements.
- Investigate inventory discrepancies and reconcile incoming and outgoing product movements to maintain accurate inventory records.
- Manage purchase orders from creation through fulfillment, reviewing quantities, pricing, accuracy, completeness, and delivery requirements.
- Track open orders and proactively follow up with suppliers and internal teams on late, missed, incomplete, or otherwise problematic shipments.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers and supply chain partners while monitoring delivery performance, pricing, order accuracy, and service levels.
- Escalate and resolve supplier issues that could affect product availability or operational continuity.
- Support supplier negotiations and identify opportunities to improve pricing, terms, service levels, and overall supply chain efficiency.
- Maintain accurate supply chain reports and operational trackers using Excel or Google Sheets.
- Analyze inventory, purchasing, supplier, and shipment data to identify trends, operational risks, cost-saving opportunities, and areas for improvement.
- Provide clear reporting and visibility into supply chain performance to support informed decision-making.
- Coordinate the day-to-day priorities of a small supply chain team and help ensure work remains organized and on track.
- Partner with internal stakeholders to communicate supply chain needs, risks, and issues effectively.
- Take ownership of operational problems and follow them through to resolution while continuously improving processes, documentation, reporting, and efficiency.
  
  ### Requirements
  
  - 3–5+ years of experience in supply chain, procurement, purchasing, inventory management, supply planning, or a related field.
  - Previous experience leading, supervising, or mentoring supply chain team members is preferred.
  - Strong practical experience managing inventory and purchasing or procurement activities.
  - Experience working directly with suppliers and managing purchase orders through fulfillment.
  - Strong analytical capabilities and confidence working with significant volumes of operational data.
  - Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets.
  - Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing, or supply chain management systems.
  - Strong attention to detail, with the ability to identify discrepancies and address issues before they become larger operational problems.
  - Excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive, ownership-oriented approach.
  - Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  - Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with a US-based team.
  - Willingness and ability to work during US business hours.
  - Experience in restaurants, food and beverage, FMCG/CPG, retail, food manufacturing, distribution, or another inventory-intensive environment is preferred.
  - Experience with demand or supply planning and forecasting is a plus.
  - Experience managing supplier performance and negotiating with vendors is advantageous.
  - Experience identifying cost-saving opportunities or leading process improvements is preferred.
  - Experience supporting or leading a small team of planners, analysts, buyers, or supply chain coordinators is a plus.
  - Familiarity with business intelligence or reporting tools is an advantage.
  - Strong ownership, organization, independence, and ability to work effectively in a fast-paced operational environment.
    
    ### Benefits
    
    - Full-time, remote opportunity.
    - Remote work flexibility from India or the Philippines.
    - Schedule aligned with US business hours.
    - Opportunity to work with a growing international organization and collaborate with a US-based team.
    - Hands-on ownership across inventory, purchasing, supplier management, planning, and supply chain analytics.
    - Opportunity to influence cost efficiency and improve supply chain processes.
    - Exposure to cross-functional operations and supplier management in an inventory-intensive business.
    - Opportunity to support and help develop a small supply chain team.
    - Practical written assessment as part of the hiring process to evaluate role-relevant skills.

The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

jobs.description:
With over 140 years of innovation and service excellence, Burroughs keeps technology running for some of the largest financial institutions and retailers across North America. Through our North American network of field service professionals and digital support teams, we deliver full lifecycle management for payment and transaction automation, self-service, robotic, and IoT technologies—ensuring our customers experience maximum uptime and performance every day. At Burroughs, we believe in growing our people as much as we grow our technology services. Many of our leaders began their careers in the field, and their success stories continue to inspire new generations of technicians, engineers, and support professionals. Our work is diverse, dynamic, challenging, and rewarding—but for those with curiosity, integrity, and a drive to learn, Burroughs is a place to build a lasting and meaningful career.

### Job Summary:

Areas of responsibility for the Supply Chain Analyst includes tracking and reconciling the return of customer and Burroughs-owned assets, arranging for the pick-up of assets from vendors or customer sites, assisting with the system set-up of for new field technicians, reporting performance metrics. Analysts are expected to participate in company efforts to implement continuous improvement initiatives and consolidate systems. This is a remote position.

### Essential Functions/Key Responsibilities:

- Process Inventory transactions necessary to move assets between BRC/Main Warehouse locations to 3PL and field technician sites
- Prepare reporting metrics for departmental key performance indicators.
- Receive parts from field technicians into the BRC repair system database
- Communicate receiving discrepancies with Field Operations.
- Reconcile customer owned inventory received at the wrong location and work with other Logistics Analysts to ensure parts get returned to the proper place
- Provide feedback to Repair Operations Manager on parts needed at 3PL locations
- Prepare product not yet supported or product with excess demand for shipment to 3 party repair vendors.
- Participate in the implementation of continuous process improvements within Supply Chain.
- Assist with training Field Operations personnel on proper part return procedures for Burroughs customers.
- Prepare reporting metrics for departmental key performance indicators.
- Participate in efforts to integrate ERP systems.
- Other related tasks as assigned.

### Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

- Problem Solving/Analysis
- Team centered/work well with co-workers to resolve issues and problems
- Customer Service focus
- Strong communication skills (verbal and written)
- Ability to work independently
- Leadership
- Attention to detail
- Thoroughness

### Education and Experience:

- High school diploma or GED required.
- Prior logistics or equivalent business experience required.
- Standard Microsoft applications, including Windows, Outlook, Excel, and Word preferred

### Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:

- While performing the duties of this job, the team member is regularly required to stand. The team member is frequently required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls and to climb or balance.
- The team member is occasionally required to walk; reach with hands and arms; stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl; and talk or hear.
- The team member must regularly lift and move up to 10 pounds, frequently lift and move up to 25 pounds and occasionally lift and move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Other Duties: Please note that this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required by the team member for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Burroughs is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Drug Free Workplace. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status or disability.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Manager, Procurement & Materials Planning
jobs.description:
Javvy is on a mission to set a new standard for café favorites with better-for-you beverages that are craveable, convenient, and without compromise. Positioned at the intersection of café culture, convenience, and functional nutrition, we’re reimagining the drinks people buy every day — proving you don’t have to compromise between great taste and quality ingredients. What began as a cult-favorite DTC brand has rapidly scaled into an omnichannel business, now expanding into major retail while building a loyal community around better-for-you café favorites.

## **The Opportunity:**

We're looking for an experienced Supply Chain Manager to own materials planning, procurement, and supplier management for all of Javvy's raw materials, packaging, and accessories — the ingredients and components that feed production across our network of co-manufacturers.

This role owns the flow of materials from plan to purchase order to receipt: running the material MRP, monitoring coverage and shortages, placing the right orders at the right time, and following inbound supply through to the dock. It also owns our supplier relationships and commercial negotiations, with direct impact on product availability, operational efficiency, and company margin. You'll play a critical role in building the planning and procurement processes and tools that support Javvy's rapid growth across retail, ecommerce, and new product expansion.

This is a highly cross-functional role, reporting to the Director of Supply Chain and partnering closely with Demand Planning, Production & Co-Manufacturing, Purchasing, Operations, Finance, R&D, and Quality. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on materials planning and procurement experience,understands how supply decisions impact the broader business and P&L, and thrives in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

## **What You’ll Own:**

**Materials Planning & Purchasing**

- Own the material requirements plan (MRP) and planning file for all raw materials, packaging, and accessories across multiple co-manufacturers, keeping it current, accurate, and trusted by the team
- Translate the demand and production plan into material requirements by co-manufacturer, accounting for BOMs, on-hand and on-order inventory, MOQs, and supplier lead times
- Monitor material coverage and upcoming shortages on a weekly and daily cadence, with a clear view of the next 12+ weeks of production
- Turn planning signals into timely purchase orders with the right quantities, order increments, and delivery timing to each co-manufacturer
- Balance supply continuity against inventory and cash, avoiding both stockouts and excess or obsolete material
- Surface shortages, risks, and trade-offs early, and drive them to resolution with Demand Planning, Production, and suppliers

**Inbound Execution & Inventory Accuracy**

- Follow up on every open PO: confirm orders, track ETAs, and expedite when shipments slip — especially long-lead and imported materials
- Keep inbound schedules current and communicate changes to Production & Co-Manufacturing before they become line-down risks
- Keep ERP accurate for purchasing and inventory: POs, item receipts, and receipt-to-invoice matching with Finance
- Coordinate with suppliers, freight forwarders, and co-manufacturers to resolve receiving discrepancies, shortages, and quality holds on inbound material

**Strategic Sourcing & Supplier Management**

- Serve as the single owner of Javvy's raw material, packaging, and accessory suppliers, managing sourcing across our ingredient and component base
- Build and maintain strategic supplier relationships focused on quality, reliability, scalability, and long-term partnership
- Identify, evaluate, qualify, and onboard new and alternate suppliers to improve cost structure, operational flexibility, and supply resilience
- Lead supplier negotiations including pricing, contracts, MOQs, lead times, payment terms, and service levels
- Partner with suppliers on capacity planning to support demand growth and supply continuity

**Cost Optimization & Business Strategy**

- Understand key business and P&L drivers and translate them into procurement and supplier strategies aligned with margin targets and operational priorities
- Monitor commodity markets, tariffs, freight trends, and supply market dynamics impacting cost and availability
- Drive cost savings initiatives and continuous improvement efforts across sourcing categories
- Manage RFQs, RFPs, and competitive bid processes for strategic sourcing initiatives
- Maintain pricing analysis, spend reporting, and supplier performance metrics to support forecasting and budgeting

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

- Partner daily with Demand Planning and Production & Co-Manufacturing to align material supply with the production schedule and maintain appropriate inventory levels
- Partner with Finance on inventory, receiving, and invoice accuracy
- Collaborate with R&D and Quality teams to qualify new ingredients, packaging components, accessories, and product changes
- Support innovation and new product launches through material planning, supplier coordination, and sourcing execution
- Ensure suppliers meet regulatory, food safety, and quality standards

**Process, Systems & Tools**

- Build, not just run: design and improve the planning, purchasing, and follow-up processes and tools (MRP, coverage and shortage reporting, PO tracking) as the business scales
- Build and maintain supplier scorecards and KPI tracking (e.g., supplier on-time-in-full, lead-time adherence, material shortages, weeks of supply)
- Own procurement and inventory data in NetSuite and help improve how our systems support planning and purchasing
- Establish scalable best practices and documentation around materials planning, purchasing, vendor management, and sourcing operations

## What We’re Looking For

- 3-5+ years of materials planning, procurement, sourcing, or supply chain experience
- Hands-on experience running MRP or material planning — translating demand and production plans into material requirements and purchase orders
- Proven ability to manage day-to-day purchasing and follow-up: placing POs, tracking open orders, expediting, and resolving inbound issues
- Experience planning materials for external co-manufacturers or contract manufacturers, including landing materials at the plant ahead of production
- Strong supplier management and negotiation experience with a track record of driving cost savings and operational improvements
- Experience managing RFQs, contracts, supplier onboarding, and vendor performance
- Experience with supply continuity and supplier risk management
- Strong understanding of business financials and P&L drivers, with the ability to translate financial goals into procurement and sourcing strategy
- Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills and strong attention to data accuracy (inventory, units of measure, receipts)
- Familiarity with ERP systems and procurement tools; NetSuite experience strongly preferred
- Experience working within high-growth companies across industries such as CPG, food & beverage, consumer products, supplements, or other fast-scaling brands
- Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment with shifting priorities — equally at home in the daily details and in building better processes
- Self-directed and highly organized in a remote setting, with clear, proactive written and verbal communication
- Effective cross-functional collaborator with strong ownership and follow-through
- Nice to Have
  
  - Experience with imported ingredients: long lead times, freight forwarders, customs, and managing slipping ETAs
  - Background in powdered food, beverage, or supplement ingredients (e.g., proteins, collagen, flavors, dairy powders)
  - APICS/ASCM CPIM or ISM CPSM certification
  - Experience building planning tools, dashboards, or reporting from scratch

## Why This Role Rocks:

  *(Family coverage available at employee cost)*

jobs.title: Supply Chain Manager (all genders)
jobs.description:
Position: Vollzeit (40h)

Ort: Remote (Deutschland) oder Berlin

Start Datum: Ab sofort oder nach Absprache

Sprachen: Deutsch (fließend) & Englisch (sehr gut)

**Du hast den Anspruch, dass jede Bestellung stimmt, die deinen Tisch verlässt, und führst Lieferanten in Asien so eng, dass Ware pünktlich und in der richtigen Qualität ankommt?**

Dann bist du bei uns richtig. Als Supply Chain Manager (all genders) verantwortest du bei Maniko die operative Beschaffung von der Bestellempfehlung bis zum Wareneingang. Von deiner Arbeit hängt ab, ob unsere Produkte in den Regalen der größten Drogerieketten verfügbar sind.

**Das sind wir!**

Maniko ist ein innovatives, schnell wachsendes Unternehmen in der Nagelkosmetik-Branche, das hochwertige Produkte für anspruchsvolle Kundinnen europaweit anbietet. Wir sind bekannt für unsere selbstklebende UV Gel Nail Strips-Technologie, die professionelle Ergebnisse bequem von zu Hause aus ermöglicht – und haben mit unseren Soft Gel Press-On Nails eine zweite starke Produktlinie im Markt.

Unsere Produkte stehen national bei dm, dm Österreich, Rossmann und budni im Regal, und unser Handelsgeschäft wächst weiter. Aus dem Startup ist ein Unternehmen geworden, das im Regal mit den großen Beauty-Marken konkurriert. Groß genug, dass deine Arbeit in tausenden Filialen sichtbar wird, und beweglich genug, dass du Strukturen noch selbst baust, statt sie zu verwalten.

Unser Geheimnis? Ein leidenschaftliches Team, das sich nicht mit dem Status quo zufrieden gibt und ständig danach strebt, besser zu werden. Wir glauben an Werte, die wirklich gelebt werden – keine leeren Phrasen. Bei uns heißt es:

- **Facts over Ego:** Daten und Ergebnisse stehen über allem – bei uns zählt das Beste für das Team und das Unternehmen, nicht das persönliche Ego.
- **Challenge accepted:** Wir sehen in jeder Herausforderung eine Chance, an der wir wachsen können.
- **Power to the people:** Vertrauen und Verantwortung gehen bei uns Hand in Hand – dein Impact zählt!
- **Who if not you?**: Wenn nicht du die Ärmel hochkrempelst und Dinge anpackst – wer dann?

**Deine Rolle bei uns:**

Du bist Owner unserer operativen Beschaffung und berichtest direkt an unseren COO. Aus der monatlichen Absatz- und Bestandsplanung machst du Bestellungen, die pünktlich, vollständig und in vereinbarter Qualität ankommen, und führst dafür unsere Hersteller in Asien und Europa. Dein Erfolg ist messbar: an der Liefertreue unserer Lieferanten und an der Fehlerquote in den Bestellungen.

**Deine Aufgaben sind**:

- Du verantwortest den Bestellprozess für Fertigware, Komponenten, Verpackung und POS-Material, von der Bestellempfehlung über die Freigabe bis zum Wareneingang.
- Du führst unsere Hersteller in Asien und Europa durch Auftragsbestätigung, Produktion, Qualitätsprüfung vor Verschiffung und Versanddokumente. Bei Verzug eskalierst du früh und bringst eine Lösung mit.
- Du misst Lieferantenleistung über eine Scorecard (Termintreue, Qualität, Reaktionszeit) und machst Abweichungen sichtbar, bevor sie zum Problem werden.
- Du hältst Stücklisten, Spezifikationen und Artikeldaten so sauber, dass sich Planung, Logistik und Handel darauf verlassen können.
- Du steuerst mit Finance Anzahlungen und Fälligkeiten und stellst sicher, dass Zertifikate und Konformitätsnachweise unserer Lieferanten vollständig vorliegen.
- Du entwickelst den Prozess weiter: Standards für neue Lieferanten und Komponenten, Kontrollen, Automatisierung. Wo ein Tool oder KI dir Arbeit abnimmt, setzt du es ein.

**Was du mitbringst:**

- Du hast mehrere Jahre operative Beschaffung mit Herstellern in Asien eigenverantwortlich gesteuert, idealerweise für eine Konsumgütermarke mit Handelsbelieferung.
- Du arbeitest genau, weil du ein System dafür hast, nicht weil du langsam bist. Du kannst zeigen, wie du Fehler abfängst, bevor eine Bestellung rausgeht.
- Du führst Lieferanten freundlich und hartnäckig, auch über Zeitzonen hinweg, und bleibst dran, bis ein Termin wirklich steht.
- Du wartest nicht auf Anweisung. Wenn etwas schiefläuft, sprichst du es früh an und bringst einen Vorschlag mit.
- Du bist sehr sicher in Excel/Sheets, sprichst fließend Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch.

**Idealerweise bringst du außerdem mit:**

- Erfahrung mit Komponenten aus der Beauty-/Kosmetik- oder FMCG-Branche (z. B. Verpackung, Applikatoren).
- ERP- bzw. Dispo-Erfahrung (PO-Workflows, Stammdaten).
- Erfahrung mit Pre-Shipment-Inspections bzw. QC-Dienstleistern.

**Was wir dir bieten:**

- **🇪🇺 100 % Remote in Deutschland:** Remote-first mit optionalem Büro in Berlin. Der Reiseanteil ist gering, gelegentliche Lieferantenbesuche gehören dazu.
- **⏱️ Flexible Arbeitszeiten:** Somit kannst du privates und berufliches flexibel und entspannt vereinbaren.
- **🚉 Deutschlandticket:** Für mehr Flexibilität und Mobilität.
- **🏃‍♀️Urban Sports Club Membership:** Weil wir wissen, wie wichtig physische Gesundheit und Ausgleich ist.
- **🤝 Ownership:** Durch viel Vertrauen & Gestaltungsspielraum hast du direkten Einfluss auf den Erfolg unseres Unternehmens und gestaltest maßgeblich unser Wachstum mit.
- **🌴 Workation:** Deine Möglichkeit Urlaub und Arbeit zu verbinden.
- **📈 Wachstumschancen:** Sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich. Bei uns kannst du dich weiterentwickeln und neue Wege gehen, unterstützt durch ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget.
- **🎉 Team-Events:** Wir laden alle Mitarbeiter:innen regelmäßig nach Berlin ein, um eine gute Zeit zusammen zu haben und noch besser connecten zu können.
- **🖥️ Home-Office Ausstattung:** Wir übernehmen deine komplette Ausstattung, damit du auch zu Hause direkt durchstarten kannst.
- **✈️ Individuelles Travelbudget:** Für deine Besuche in Berlin, um gemeinsam mit dem Team aus dem Office zu arbeiten.
- **👥 Team:** Ein schnelles, hochmotiviertes Team mit Office im Herzen von Berlin (Hackescher Markt).
- **✨ Eine Kultur, die inspiriert:** Bei uns zählt jeder Einzelne. Flache Hierarchien, schnelle Entscheidungen und echte Teamarbeit stehen im Mittelpunkt.

**Challenge accepted?** Dann bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil eines Teams, das große Ziele verfolgt und dabei nie den Spaß verliert.  
Wir freuen uns auf dich!
